### He is the One He Says He Is
Author: Dawn Mast
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement-cafe/he-is-the-one-he-says-he-is-encouragement-caf-jan-13-2015.html
Passage: Numbers 23:19
Points:
- Unlike people who wear disguises or act falsely, God never pretends to be someone He is not.
- As the eternal Lord, God faithfully keeps every promise He makes without changing His mind.
- Looking to fallible human beings to fulfill what only God can provide inevitably brings disappointment.
- When others let us down, believers should offer space and grace rather than placing people in God's role.
- Hurt feelings should drive us to our knees in prayer, seeking God's forgiveness and obedience.
